narrative: Recent developments showcase significant strides in AI, particularly in agentic systems and model efficiency, alongside new hardware innovations and insights into technology and science. Enterprises are increasingly integrating AI into core workflows, while consumer tech sees advancements in tracking, audio, and power solutions.

highlights.title: Agriculture relies on fossil fuels. It’s costing us.
highlights.whyItMatters: Rising fossil fuel prices are significantly impacting agriculture, particularly fertilizer costs.

highlights.title: Scaling agentic AI pilots across the enterprise
highlights.whyItMatters: Enterprises face challenges in integrating agentic AI into business workflows despite widespread adoption.

highlights.title: Microsoft discloses Azure revenue as part of major financial reporting changes
highlights.whyItMatters: Microsoft's new financial reporting reflects the growing impact of AI, with Azure revenue now separately disclosed.

highlights.title: Belkin’s first trackers come ready to attach to your gear.
highlights.whyItMatters: Belkin introduces new trackers compatible with Apple Find My and Google Find Hub, offering broader tracking options.

highlights.title: Anker’s sleep speaker uses radar and flower power to help you relax
highlights.whyItMatters: Anker's new SleepLab speaker leverages radar and unique features to enhance sleep tracking and relaxation without wearables.

highlights.title: Give Your Coding Agents a Memory You Own
highlights.whyItMatters: New developments allow coding agents to maintain user-owned memory, enhancing their long-term capabilities.

highlights.title: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash, its third Flash model in six weeks
highlights.whyItMatters: Google continues to rapidly evolve its Gemini Flash models, underscoring ongoing advancements in AI technology.

highlights.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
highlights.whyItMatters: OpenAI's Astra model introduces a novel reasoning technique ('recurrent depth') raising concerns among AI safety experts.
